instruction: A clean studio portrait captured in a medium shot at eye-level against a plain white wall. On the right, the woman with short blonde hair in a pink blazer (R1) stands facing forward with her arms crossed, maintaining a serious expression directed at the camera. To her left, the woman with short brown hair and glasses in a light blue blazer (R2) stands slightly behind, resting her right hand gently on the shoulder of the woman in the pink blazer (R1) while smiling softly at the camera. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused front lighting that highlights the pastel tones of their blazers against the bright, minimalist background.
